title.zh: 将国立 Kidney 学院的名称变更为国立 Kidney 与 Transplant 学院，并为其他目的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the National Kidney Institute to National Kidney and Transplant Institute and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the National Kidney Institute to National Kidney and Transplant Institute and for Other Purposes
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên National Kidney Institute thành National Kidney and Transplant Institute
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ National Kidney Institute เป็น National Kidney and Transplant Institute
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama National Kidney Institute menjadi National Kidney and Transplant Institute
title.ms: Akta menukar nama National Kidney Institute menjadi National Kidney and Transplant Institute

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_8020_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The National Kidney Institute is hereby renamed as the National Kidney and Transplant Institute and shall be designated as the lead center for organ transplantation.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
